title: Compactification comparison normalizes bounded etale-origin transposes
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$, $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], with chosen compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and $\dim\overline X\leq D$ for an integer $D\geq0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Neither $X$ nor $Y$ is required to be separated over $k$. On ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $F_e=Rp_{e,*}j_!^e$, $F_p=Rp_{p,*}j_!^p$ for compact supports [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and $f^\times$ for the right adjoint of $F_e$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Use $Rf^!=C_Xf^\times R\nu_{Y,*}$ with the bounded etale-origin adjunction of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Define
$$B_{f,J}=Rp_{p,*}(e_{j,J})\circ\beta_{p,j_!^eJ}:C_YF_eJ\xrightarrow{\sim}F_pC_XJ$$
from the counit-mate proper comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] and adjoint extension-by-zero comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Explicitly, the phrase “chosen-compactification normalization” fixes the Hom bijection as follows; it is not an arbitrary adjunction structure on these functors. Put $U_T=R\nu_{T,*}$ and let $\eta_T,\tau_T$ be the unit and counit of $C_T\dashv U_T$. For $G\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, the specified bijection sends $z:F_pC_XG\to L$ to
$$\Phi_{G,L}(z)=C_X\!\left(\operatorname{adj}_e\left(U_Y(z\circ B_{f,G})\circ\eta_{Y,F_eG}\right)\right).$$
Here $\operatorname{adj}_e$ has target $\operatorname{Hom}(G,f^\times U_YL)$; the last operation is the fully faithful comparison at $X$. This spells out the bounded etale-origin Hom-chain construction, using the identity witness and the same compactification $c$ throughout.
Let $J\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ with $f^\times K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. The comparison unit $K\xrightarrow{\sim}R\nu_{Y,*}C_YK$ [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] induces
$$\rho_K:C_Xf^\times K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^!C_YK.$$
For the etale counit $\varepsilon^e_K:F_ef^\times K\to K$, its image under $C_Y$, precomposed by $B_{f,f^\times K}^{-1}$, is the bounded etale-origin counit followed by the identification $\rho_K^{-1}$ on the right-adjoint object. Equivalently,
$$\varepsilon^p_{C_YK}\circ F_p(\rho_K)\circ B_{f,f^\times K}=C_Y(\varepsilon^e_K).$$
Consequently, for every $a_e:F_eJ\to K$ and $a_p:F_pC_XJ\to C_YK$ with $a_p B_{f,J}=C_Y(a_e)$, their specified adjunction transposes obey
$$\operatorname{adj}_p(a_p)=\rho_K\circ C_X(\operatorname{adj}_e(a_e)).$$
This comparison uses only the bounded-below etale-origin adjunction, with its chosen-compactification normalization, and is natural in $J,K$. It makes no assertion of an ambient pro-etale exceptional adjunction on all unbounded objects.

proof.text: Precomposition with B, the comparison adjunction, the supplied etale adjunction, and C_X.map form the specified function. The first three factors are equivalences. The last is bijective by bounded-target comparison full faithfulness [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], using the lower bound of Step 2. Function.Bijective.comp proves boundedSiteTranspose_bijective. The existing Equiv.ofBijective then determines the inverse and the counit; apply_symm_apply proves that the counit transposes to the identity.

proof.text: For compatible a_e and a_p substitute a_p B = C_Y(a_e) into the specified transpose. Naturality of the comparison unit identifies the comparison transpose of C_Y(a_e) with a_e followed by eta_Y,K. Naturality in the target of the supplied etale Hom equivalence and functoriality of C_X identify the result with C_X(adj_e(a_e)) followed by rho_K. This proves the generic compatibility helper directly.

source.place: Tag 0B65, counit normalization, expanded using naturality and the comparison triangle identity

proof.text: The comparison unit at bounded-below K is invertible by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]; both H and C_X preserve isomorphisms, so rho_K is invertible. Apply injectivity of the Hom-chain bijection to F_p(rho_K) followed by the specified counit, and to B inverse followed by C_Y of the etale counit. Source naturality and Step 3 send the first map to rho_K. Step 4 sends the second map to rho_K, because the etale counit transposes to the identity. Precompose the resulting equality by B to obtain the required normalized counit equation. Step 4 also gives the asserted transpose equality for every compatible pair.

proof.text: Use inverse naturality of compactSupportSiteComparison and the source naturality of both adjunction Hom equivalences to prove source naturality of the specified transpose. Target naturality follows from target naturality of both equivalences. Naturality of rho is C_X H applied to naturality of the actual comparison unit. Functor.map_comp and the category associativity laws close all three equations.
